description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, with 12 distinct slices shown. The categories and their corresponding approximate percentages are: AI/NLP Research (24.3%, blue), Econ. & Fin. (18.4%, teal), Game&Anime (8.2%, dark orange), History (8.2%, yellow), Daily Life (7.1%, light green), Science (6.7%, pink), Business (5.9%, red), Med & Health (5.5%, gray), Law (5.1%, light blue), Geography (2.7%, orange), and Math (1.2%, green). The chart does not include a legend, but percentage labels are shown outside the chart, connected to their corresponding slices by lines. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
